This '''[[Short sword]]''' was once used by [[Sanasiki]] to kill [[Nelinik]], a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. It was made with a [[cortosis-weave]] to defend against [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and [[Energy cell/Legends|energy cells]] to disrupt [[Droid/Legends|droids]].
